steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurmak için güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunu ister.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduktan sonra Initiation of communication session mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, trackside'dan gelen sistem sürümünü alır ve oturumu kurulmuş olarak kabul eder.

test_cases.title: Trackside emriyle iletişim oturumu kurulumu

steps.expected: OBU, emri alır ve RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurmak için güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunu ister.

steps.expected: OBU, sistem sürümünü alır ve oturumu kurulmuş olarak kabul eder.

steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurmak için güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunu ister.

steps.expected: OBU, yeni bir iletişim oturumu kurmak için güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunu ister.

steps.expected: OBU, sistem sürümünü alır ve oturumu kurulmuş olarak kabul eder.

test_cases.title: Start of Mission dışında manuel RBC seçimiyle oturum kurulumu

steps.action: Sürücü, RBC iletişim bilgilerini manuel olarak seçer.
steps.expected: OBU, seçilen RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurmak için güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunu ister.

steps.action: Oturum kurulum süreci tamamlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, sistem sürümünü alır ve oturumu kurulmuş olarak kabul eder.

test_cases.title: Başarısız radyo bağlantı isteğinin tekrarlanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modundadır. Start of Mission prosedürü aktif değildir.

steps.action: İletişim oturumu kurma tetikleyicisi devreye girer ve OBU güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumunu ister.
steps.expected: EURORADIO, bağlantı kurulumunun başarısız olduğunu bildirir.

steps.action: OBU, bağlantı kurulum isteğini tekrarlar.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlantı kurulana kadar isteği tekrarlar.

steps.action: Bağlantı kurulduktan sonra Initiation of communication session mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, sistem sürümünü alır ve oturumu kurulmuş olarak kabul eder.

test_cases.title: Uyumsuz sistem sürümü durumunda oturum sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modundadır. Trackside, OBU'nun desteklemediği bir sistem sürümü gönderir.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulur ve Initiation of communication session mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: Trackside, OBU'nun desteklemediği bir sistem sürümü gönderir.

steps.action: OBU, uyumsuz sürümü algılar.
steps.expected: OBU, 'No compatible version supported' mesajını gönderir, sürücüyü bilgilendirir ve oturumu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında masa kapatma ile iptal

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu sırasında sürücü masayı kapatır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder ve güvenli radyo bağlantısını (varsa) serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission ile iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modundadır. Oturum kurulumu devam etmektedir.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission prosedürü başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder ve güvenli radyo bağlantısını (varsa) serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında trackside sonlandırma emriyle iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modundadır. Oturum kurulumu devam etmektedir.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu sırasında trackside'dan oturum sonlandırma emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder ve güvenli radyo bağlantısını (varsa) serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında Level 2 sınırını geçişle iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modundadır. Oturum kurulumu devam etmektedir. Tren, Level 2 alanından Level 2 desteklenmeyen bir alana geçiş yapacak konumdadır.

steps.action: Trenin minimum güvenli arka ucu, Level 2 alanından Level 2 desteklenmeyen bir alana geçiş sınırını geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder ve güvenli radyo bağlantısını (varsa) serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında RBC/RBC sınırını geçişle iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modundadır. Oturum kurulumu devam etmektedir. Tren, bir RBC/RBC sınırını geçecek konumdadır.

steps.action: Trenin minimum güvenli arka ucu, bir RBC/RBC sınırını geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu iptal eder ve güvenli radyo bağlantısını (varsa) serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC kimliğiyle oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modundadır. OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır.

steps.action: Trackside'dan, 'son bilinen RBC' anlamına gelen özel RBC kimlik değerini içeren bir iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, emirdeki telefon numarasını yok sayar ve saklanan RBC iletişim bilgilerini kullanarak RBC'ye bağlanır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulum süreci tamamlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, sistem sürümünü alır ve oturumu kurulmuş olarak kabul eder.

test_cases.title: Saklanan RBC bilgisi yokken son bilinen RBC emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modundadır. OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmamıştır.

steps.action: Trackside'dan, 'son bilinen RBC' anlamına gelen özel RBC kimlik değerini içeren bir iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, emri yok sayar ve iletişim oturumu kurmaz.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on trackside order for FRMCS-only RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is equipped with both GSM-R and FRMCS radio systems. A trackside order to establish a communication session is received targeting an RBC that is FRMCS-only.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order specifying an FRMCS-only RBC identity.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where it can initiate a communication session (e.g., Level 2).

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC identified as FRMCS-only.
steps.expected: The OBU selects the FRMCS radio system to request the safe radio connection set-up.

steps.action: Observe the radio system used for the initial connection request.
steps.expected: The connection request is transmitted via the FRMCS interface.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on driver's single-radio choice at Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is equipped with both GSM-R and FRMCS radio systems. No trackside order specifying a radio system is active. The driver has selected 'GSM-R only' as the single-radio choice during the Start of Mission procedure.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver selection of 'GSM-R only' during Start of Mission.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in Level 2 and initiating a session due to Start of Mission.

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission with the driver selecting 'GSM-R only' as the radio system preference.
steps.expected: The OBU records the driver's choice.

steps.action: Trigger the establishment of a communication session (e.g., via Start of Mission completion).
steps.expected: The OBU selects the GSM-R radio system to request the safe radio connection set-up, ignoring stored preferred radio system if different.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on stored Radio Network information and preferred radio system
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is equipped with both GSM-R and FRMCS radio systems. No trackside order is active. No single-radio choice was made at Start of Mission (or it was 'Both'). The stored Radio Network information indicates a GSM-R network, and the preferred radio system is set to GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: Stored configuration: Preferred Radio System = GSM-R, Radio Network = GSM-R.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in Level 2 and initiating a session due to a trigger that does not override radio selection (e.g., manual level change).

steps.action: Trigger a communication session establishment (e.g., manual level change to Level 2).
steps.expected: The OBU consults the stored Radio Network information and preferred radio system.

steps.action: Observe the radio system used for the connection request.
steps.expected: The OBU selects the GSM-R radio system to request the safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Memorization of radio system used for successful safe radio connection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is equipped with both GSM-R and FRMCS radio systems. A communication session is initiated and the safe radio connection is successfully established using the FRMCS radio system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Successful FRMCS connection setup.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to store the last successfully used radio system.

steps.action: Establish a communication session where the safe radio connection is successfully set up via FRMCS.
steps.expected: The OBU completes the session establishment process.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state or log for the memorized radio system used for the last successful safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU reports that FRMCS was the radio system used for the successful connection.

test_cases.title: Memorization of radio system after switching from GSM-R to FRMCS
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is equipped with both GSM-R and FRMCS radio systems. A previous session was established using GSM-R. A new session is initiated and the safe radio connection is successfully established using the FRMCS radio system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Previous state: GSM-R used. Current action: Successful FRMCS connection setup.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU updates the memorized radio system upon each successful connection.

steps.action: Verify that the OBU currently memorizes GSM-R as the last used radio system.
steps.expected: The OBU state indicates GSM-R.

steps.action: Terminate the current session and initiate a new communication session where the safe radio connection is successfully set up via FRMCS.
steps.expected: The OBU completes the new session establishment.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for the memorized radio system.
steps.expected: The OBU reports that FRMCS is now the memorized radio system, overwriting the previous GSM-R value.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open a second session with the same RBC while the first is being established
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A Start of Mission is initiated, triggering a session establishment with RBC-A. The session with RBC-A is in the 'establishing' state (handshake in progress).
test_cases.test_inputs: A second trigger for session establishment with RBC-A (e.g., a manual level change to Level 2 or a trackside order) is generated while the first session is still being established.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of detecting the state of the ongoing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission in Level 2 to start establishing a session with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU begins the process of establishing a communication session with RBC-A.

steps.action: While the session with RBC-A is still being established, trigger a second session establishment request for RBC-A (e.g., via manual level change or trackside order).
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The original establishment process continues or is handled according to abort conditions, but no duplicate session is initiated.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open a second session with the same RBC while the first is established and active
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trigger for session establishment with RBC-A (e.g., a Level 2 mode change to be reported) is generated.

steps.action: Verify that a communication session with RBC-A is established and active.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates an active session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Trigger a Level 2 mode change that requires reporting to the RBC, which would normally trigger a session establishment with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates existing session with different RBC when establishing new session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions or is configured to terminate existing sessions upon new establishment requests.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order from trackside to establish a session with RBC-B is received.
test_cases.assumptions: The order to establish a session with RBC-B is not embedded in an RBC transition order for an Accepting RBC.

steps.action: Verify that a communication session with RBC-A is established and active.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates an active session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A and begins establishing a new session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: OBU does not terminate session with supervising RBC when receiving RBC transition order for Accepting RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A (Handing Over RBC) is established and active. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions.
test_cases.test_inputs: An RBC transition order is received, which includes an order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can handle more than one communication session through GSM-R.

steps.action: Verify that a communication session with RBC-A is established and active.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates an active session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the session with RBC-A. It begins establishing a new session with RBC-B while keeping the session with RBC-A active.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates information validity direction against balise crossing direction in SL mode
test_cases.preconditions: The engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. The train orientation is North. A balise group is crossed in the South direction (reverse).
test_cases.test_inputs: Information is received from a balise group that is valid only for the South direction (crossing direction).

steps.action: Set the engine to Sleeping (SL) mode and orient the train North.
steps.expected: The OBU is in SL mode with train orientation North.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the South direction (reverse) and receive information valid only for the South direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information, as it is valid for the crossing direction (South), despite the train orientation being North.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid only for opposite direction in PS mode
test_cases.preconditions: The engine is in Passive Shunting (PS) mode. The train orientation is North. A balise group is crossed in the North direction (nominal).
test_cases.test_inputs: Information is received from a balise group that is valid only for the South direction (opposite to crossing direction).

steps.action: Set the engine to Passive Shunting (PS) mode and orient the train North.
steps.expected: The OBU is in PS mode with train orientation North.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the North direction (nominal) and receive information valid only for the South direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information, as it is valid only for the opposite direction to the crossing direction.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps applying last received MA request parameters until new ones are received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters (repetition period = 10s, triggering time criteria) have been received from RBC. The last MA request was sent 5 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new MA request parameters are received. The time since the last MA request reaches 10 seconds.

steps.action: Receive MA request parameters from RBC with a repetition period of 10 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the MA request parameters.

steps.action: Wait until 10 seconds have passed since the last MA request, without receiving new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request, as the time since the last request is equal to the repetition period.

test_cases.title: OBU sends MA request immediately if new parameters are received when time since last request >= new repetition period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters (repetition period = 20s) have been received from RBC. The last MA request was sent 15 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters are received from RBC with a repetition period of 10 seconds.

steps.action: Receive MA request parameters from RBC with a repetition period of 20 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the MA request parameters.

steps.action: Wait 15 seconds since the last MA request, then receive new MA request parameters from RBC with a repetition period of 10 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request immediately, as the time since the last request (15s) is higher than the newly received repetition period (10s).

test_cases.title: OBU does not define SvL while supervising a Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The train is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero. SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are present in the track description.
test_cases.test_inputs: The train moves within the LOA.

steps.action: Configure the OBU to supervise a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero.
steps.expected: The OBU is supervising the LOA.

steps.action: Move the train within the LOA, passing SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section).
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any Supervised Location (SvL) on board. None of the SvL candidates are used as SvL.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps Level 1 signalling related speed restriction valid until new one is received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h has been received and is valid.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new signalling related speed restriction is received. The train continues in Level 1.

steps.action: Receive a signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h in Level 1.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the 80 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Continue in Level 1 without receiving a new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU keeps the 80 km/h speed restriction valid.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps Level 1 signalling related speed restriction valid after switching to Level 2 until Level 2 MA is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h has been received and is valid. The OBU switches to Level 2.
test_cases.test_inputs: The OBU switches to Level 2. No Level 2 MA is accepted yet.

steps.action: Receive a signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h in Level 1.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the 80 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU is in Level 2.

steps.action: Do not accept a Level 2 MA.
steps.expected: The OBU keeps the 80 km/h signalling related speed restriction valid.

test_cases.title: OBU handles Maximum Train Speed as Static Speed Restriction category
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The train's actual performance and configuration allow a maximum speed of 200 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: The Maximum Train Speed is defined as 200 km/h.

steps.action: Define the Maximum Train Speed as 200 km/h based on the train's actual performance and configuration.
steps.expected: The OBU handles the 200 km/h value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

steps.action: Check the speed restriction applied by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the 200 km/h speed restriction as a Static Speed Restriction.

test_cases.title: OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as initial state for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. No speed restriction has been computed from data received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: No speed restriction data is received from trackside.

steps.action: Start the OBU in Level 2 without receiving any speed restriction data from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the initial state for speed restrictions to ensure permitted braking distance.

steps.action: Check the speed limit applied by the OBU.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: OBU resumes 'no speed restriction' state when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A speed restriction of 100 km/h has been computed and is applied.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside orders the initial state to be resumed.

steps.action: Apply a speed restriction of 100 km/h based on data received from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the 100 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the state for speed restrictions to ensure permitted braking distance.

steps.action: Check the speed limit applied by the OBU.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt upon radio loss
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection was previously set up via GSM-R (or the specific active radio system).
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the initial connection is available and functional for reconnection.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO indication.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection using the same radio system as before.

steps.action: Allow the reconnection process to complete successfully.
steps.expected: A new safe radio connection is established, and the communication session is maintained.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio interference causing initial reconnection failures, followed by restored signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for session termination has not yet elapsed.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate a failure in the first reconnection attempt (e.g., no response from trackside).
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate a failure in the second reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection again.

steps.action: Restore radio signal quality to allow successful connection.
steps.expected: The OBU successfully establishes the safe radio connection and stops repeating attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated due to timeout
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated persistent radio loss exceeding the defined time limit for session maintenance.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for considering the session terminated is known and configurable for testing.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Prevent reconnection success and wait until the defined time for session termination elapses.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session as terminated.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior after the session is considered terminated.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the repeated attempts to set up the safe radio connection for this specific session context (as per 3.5.4.3 condition 'session is considered as terminated').

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. An RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio loss and train movement passing the specified RIU location.
test_cases.assumptions: The RIU order contains a valid location for session termination.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Move the train past the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the repeated attempts to set up the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by explicit trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A 'Termination of communication session' order message from the RBC.

steps.action: Send a 'Termination of communication session' order from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of communication session' message to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by internal condition without trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The OBU is configured to trigger termination upon a specific internal condition (e.g., loss of valid movement authority or specific mode change defined in SUBSET-026).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger the internal termination condition within the OBU.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific internal condition is defined and testable in the OBU implementation.

steps.action: Trigger the internal termination condition in the OBU without sending any trackside order.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of communication session' message to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No termination initiated without valid trigger
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No trackside order is received and no internal termination condition is met.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time for session maintenance without triggering any termination condition or receiving an order.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message. The session remains active.

test_cases.title: Repetition of Termination message upon missing acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated termination and sent the first 'Termination of communication session' message. The RBC is configured to not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (RBC silence).
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time T_wait is known from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the first 'Termination of communication session' message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a second 'Termination of communication session' message.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the second message without receiving an acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session. The RBC is configured to never send an acknowledgement.

test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions N_max is known from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.expected: The OBU sends the N_max-th 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: No repetition if acknowledgement is received within waiting time

steps.action: Send an 'Acknowledgement of termination of communication session' from the RBC within the fixed waiting time T_wait.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send any further 'Termination of communication session' messages.

test_cases.title: Display of 'Connection Up' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where a safe radio connection can be established.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid RBC/RIU is available and reachable.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection with the relevant RBC/RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates the status 'Connection Up' to the driver.

test_cases.title: Display of 'No Connection' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. No safe radio connection is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: No RBC/RIU is reachable or the connection is not requested.

steps.action: Ensure no safe radio connection is active and no setup request is ongoing.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates the status 'No Connection' to the driver.

test_cases.title: Display of 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' status
test_cases.preconditions: A safe radio connection was previously established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate a loss of connection or a failed setup attempt after the timer expires.

steps.action: Cause the safe radio connection to be lost or the setup to fail such that the transition condition for 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' is met.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates the status 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' to the driver.

test_cases.title: Timer start on first session establishment request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state to initiate a session establishment.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger a session establishment request (e.g., Start of Mission).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'connection status' timer state is observable or inferable from subsequent behavior.

steps.action: Send the first request to set up a safe radio connection for session establishment.
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer starts.

test_cases.title: Timer start on first session maintenance request
test_cases.preconditions: A session is established. The connection is lost or a maintenance request is triggered.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger a request to maintain/re-establish the communication session.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'connection status' timer state is observable or inferable from subsequent behavior.

steps.action: Send the first request to set up a safe radio connection for maintaining the session.
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer starts.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Up
test_cases.preconditions: Indication status is 'No Connection'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Establish a safe radio connection.

steps.action: Establish the safe radio connection (Condition [4]).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed
test_cases.preconditions: Indication status is 'Connection Up'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Lose the connection and stop requests (Condition [6]).

steps.action: Lose the safe radio connection and stop requests to set up the connection for a reason other than successful set-up (Condition [6]).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Lost/Set-Up failed to No Connection
test_cases.preconditions: Indication status is 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Stop requests to set up connection (Condition [3]).

steps.action: Ensure no Start of mission procedure is ongoing and stop requests to set up a safe radio connection for a reason other than successful set-up (Condition [3]).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed via timer expiry
test_cases.preconditions: Indication status is 'No Connection'. A request to set up connection has been sent and the timer is running.
test_cases.test_inputs: Wait for the 'connection status' timer to expire without successful connection.

steps.action: Allow the 'connection status' timer to expire (Condition [2]).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Indication of RIU connection status in infill area
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has safe radio connections with multiple RIUs. The train is located in an infill area served by a specific RIU.
test_cases.test_inputs: Move the train into the infill area of RIU-A while connected to RIU-A and RIU-B.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can determine the current infill area.

steps.action: Position the train in the infill area of RIU-A.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates the safe radio connection status relating to RIU-A.

test_cases.title: Valid train position stored after passing LRBG when position was unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The train position status is 'unknown' (no LRBG or ORBG stored). The train is moving towards an LRBG.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data simulating passage of an LRBG.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status in the OBU.
steps.expected: The train position status is 'unknown'.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing an LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

test_cases.title: Invalid train position deleted after passing ORBG when position was invalid
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The train position status is 'invalid' (e.g., after power-off without revalidation). The train is moving towards an ORBG.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data simulating passage of an ORBG.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status in the OBU.
steps.expected: The train position status is 'invalid'.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing an ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The previously stored invalid train position is deleted. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train orientation is relevant. Two cabs are present (Cab A and Cab B).
test_cases.test_inputs: Cab activation signals.

steps.action: Activate Cab A.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation such that the side of Cab A is considered the front of the train.

steps.action: Deactivate Cab A and activate Cab B.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation such that the side of Cab B is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train orientation is relevant. Two cabs are present (Cab A and Cab B).
test_cases.test_inputs: Cab activation/deactivation signals.

steps.action: Activate Cab A, then deactivate it.
steps.expected: The OBU records Cab A as the last active cab.

steps.action: Ensure no cab is active.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation based on the last active cab (Cab A). The side of Cab A is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Estimated front end used for supervising location based information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a valid train position. A location-based event (e.g., passing a specific track element) is configured to be supervised using the estimated front end.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data simulating passage of the location-based event.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific function does not have an explicit exception in SUBSET-026 requiring a different reference (e.g., max safe front end).

steps.action: Simulate the train approaching the location-based event.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the distance to the event using the estimated front end position.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location-based event.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers the supervision logic based on the estimated front end position crossing the event location.

test_cases.title: Max safe front end used for End Section timer start location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a valid train position. The train is approaching the End Section timer start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data simulating passage of the End Section timer start location.
test_cases.assumptions: The End Section timer start location supervision explicitly requires the max safe front end as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6 exception.

steps.action: Simulate the train approaching the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the distance to the location using the max safe front end position, not the estimated front end.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the End Section timer based on the max safe front end position crossing the location.

test_cases.title: Position reporting reference with linking consistency checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü etkinleştirilmiştir. Geçerli bir bağlantı bilgisi (linking information) alınmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı bilgisinde 'linked' olarak işaretlenmiş ve duyurulmuş bir balise grubu (LRBG1).
test_cases.assumptions: Balise grubu LRBG1, 3.6.5.1.8 koşullarını sağlayan bir LRBG uyumlu balise grubudur.

steps.action: Tren, bağlantı bilgisinde 'linked' olarak işaretlenmiş LRBG1 balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, LRBG1'i LRBGONB olarak belirler.

steps.action: RBC'den konum raporu isteği alınır veya konum raporu tetikleyici bir olay gerçekleşir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye gönderdiği konum raporunda referans nokta olarak LRBG1'i kullanır.

test_cases.title: Position reporting reference without linking consistency check
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü devre dışıdır veya yapılmamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: 'unlinked' olarak işaretlenmemiş bir balise grubu (LRBG2).
test_cases.assumptions: Balise grubu LRBG2, 3.6.5.1.8 koşullarını sağlayan bir LRBG uyumlu balise grubudur.

steps.action: Tren, 'unlinked' olarak işaretlenmemiş LRBG2 balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, LRBG2'yi LRBGONB olarak belirler.

steps.action: RBC'den konum raporu isteği alınır veya konum raporu tetikleyici bir olay gerçekleşir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye gönderdiği konum raporunda referans nokta olarak LRBG2'yi kullanır.

test_cases.title: Rejection of unlinked balise group for position reporting
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü devre dışıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: 'unlinked' olarak işaretlenmiş bir balise grubu (LRBG3).

steps.action: Tren, 'unlinked' olarak işaretlenmiş LRBG3 balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, LRBG3'ü LRBGONB olarak belirlemez. Önceki geçerli LRBGONB korunur.

steps.action: RBC'den konum raporu isteği alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, konum raporunda LRBG3'ü referans olarak kullanmaz; önceki geçerli LRBGONB'yi kullanır.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of trackside information referring to recent LRBGs
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Son 8 LRBGONB RBC'ye raporlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'den birine (örneğin 5. sonuncu LRBG) referans veren profil verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC, 3.6.2.2.2 c) maddesine göre en az 8 LRBGONB'ye referans verebilir.

steps.action: RBC, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'den birine referans veren bir mesaj gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu mesajı kabul eder ve referans alınan LRBG'ye göre konum bilgisini işler.

test_cases.title: Rejection of trackside information referring to outdated LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Son 8 LRBGONB RBC'ye raporlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'den daha eski bir LRBG'ye referans veren profil verisi.

steps.action: RBC, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'den daha eski bir LRBG'ye referans veren bir mesaj gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu mesajı reddeder veya hata durumu olarak işler, çünkü referans alınan LRBG geçerli pencere dışındadır.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid for the opposite direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in the nominal direction. The OBU is in a state where it processes trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message containing data valid for the reverse direction only.

steps.action: Transmit a balise group message to the OBU where the validity direction is set to 'reverse' while the train orientation is 'nominal'.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received data. No state change or application of the data occurs in the OBU.

test_cases.title: OBU accepts information valid for the current train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in the nominal direction. The OBU is in a state where it processes trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message containing data valid for the nominal direction.

steps.action: Transmit a balise group message to the OBU where the validity direction is set to 'nominal' while the train orientation is 'nominal'.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the data into account and processes it according to its type.

test_cases.title: OBU accepts information valid for both directions
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message containing data valid for both directions.

steps.action: Transmit a balise group message to the OBU where the validity direction is set to 'both' while the train orientation is 'nominal'.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the data into account and processes it.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation cannot be related to trackside direction

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates both-direction data when orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message containing data valid for both directions.

steps.action: Transmit a balise group message to the OBU where the validity direction is 'both' and the condition for relating orientation to trackside direction is not met.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the data.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Value applies over following incremental distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received profile data. Train is moving in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data set with value(1) and distance(2) > 0.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data where value(1) is followed by an incremental distance(2) of 100m.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value(1) for the next 100m of travel.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Previously received data applies over first distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received profile data with value(0).
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data set starting with distance(1) > 0.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data where the first element is distance(1) of 50m, followed by value(1).
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the previously received data (value(0)) for the first 50m.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Last value applies without limit unless end-of-profile
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data set ending with a value that is not the 'end of profile' special value.

steps.action: Transmit a continuous profile data set where the last value is a standard speed limit (not end-of-profile).
steps.expected: The OBU applies the last value indefinitely until new data is received.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Value followed by zero distance is taken into account
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data set where distance(n+1) is 0.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data where a value is followed by an incremental distance of 0.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the value into account immediately.

test_cases.title: Location data: Distances are unsigned increments
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data with unsigned incremental distances.

steps.action: Transmit location data where distances are provided as unsigned incremental values between consecutive values.
steps.expected: The OBU correctly interprets the distances as increments from the previous value's position.

test_cases.title: Location data: Previously received data remains in use over first distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data starting with a non-zero first distance.

steps.action: Transmit location data where the first distance is non-zero.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to use the previously received location data for the duration of the first distance.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: Elements defined by value and length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with elements (value(n), length(n)).

steps.action: Transmit non-continuous profile data consisting of elements with specific values and lengths.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets each element as a value valid for the specified length.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: Starts given by unsigned incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with unsigned incremental distances for element starts.

steps.action: Transmit non-continuous profile data where the start of each element is given by an unsigned incremental distance from the start of the previous element.
steps.expected: The OBU correctly calculates the start position of each element based on the incremental distances.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: First distance uses previously received data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data starting with a non-zero first distance.

steps.action: Transmit non-continuous profile data where the first distance is non-zero.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data (or initial/default values) for the first distance.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: Overlapping elements are accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data where elements overlap in distance.

steps.action: Transmit non-continuous profile data where the length of an element causes it to overlap with the next element's start position.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data and processes the overlapping elements according to the specification.

test_cases.title: Linking information: First distance is to the first announced balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with a first distance value.

steps.action: Transmit linking information where the first distance is specified.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the first distance as the distance to the first announced balise group.

test_cases.title: Linking information: Further distances are between consecutive balise groups

steps.expected: The OBU interprets each further distance as the distance between the corresponding consecutive balise groups.

test_cases.title: Linking information: Each value represents linking data of the corresponding balise group

test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with values associated with each balise group.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information

test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information containing location accuracy for BG-A (e.g., 10m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the stored location accuracy value for the current LRBG.

steps.action: Receive linking information that specifies a location accuracy of 10m for the upcoming balise group BG-A.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the location accuracy as 10m for BG-A.

steps.action: Detect BG-A and establish it as the LRBG.
steps.expected: The location accuracy associated with the LRBG (BG-A) is 10m.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is absent

steps.action: Detect BG-B and establish it as the LRBG without prior linking information specifying its accuracy.
steps.expected: The location accuracy associated with the LRBG (BG-B) is 20m (the National Value).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information is available for the upcoming balise group BG-C. No National Value is applicable for this location. The Default Value for location accuracy is 30m.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (no linking info, no National Value).
test_cases.assumptions: The Default Value for location accuracy is configured in the OBU as 30m.

steps.action: Detect BG-C and establish it as the LRBG.
steps.expected: The location accuracy associated with the LRBG (BG-C) is 30m (the Default Value).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated by new linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has established BG-A as LRBG with a location accuracy of 10m determined from initial linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information specifying a location accuracy of 15m for BG-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the stored location accuracy value for the current LRBG.

steps.action: Receive new linking information that specifies a location accuracy of 15m for the current LRBG (BG-A).
steps.expected: The location accuracy associated with the LRBG (BG-A) remains 10m.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has established BG-A as LRBG with a location accuracy of 10m. Linking consistency checking is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the stored location accuracy value for the current LRBG.

steps.action: Trigger a condition where linking consistency is no longer checked (e.g., loss of linking info or specific mode change).
steps.expected: The location accuracy associated with the LRBG (BG-A) remains 10m.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has established BG-A as LRBG with a location accuracy of 10m determined from linking information. The train moves into an area where a different National Value (e.g., 25m) becomes applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the stored location accuracy value for the current LRBG.

steps.action: Move the train into a zone where a new National Value for location accuracy (25m) becomes applicable.
steps.expected: The location accuracy associated with the LRBG (BG-A) remains 10m.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with standard parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. LRBG is BG-A with location accuracy 10m. Odometer over-reading is 5m, under-reading is 5m. No consist length uncertainty applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the min safe front end and max safe front end positions relative to the estimated front end.

steps.action: Observe the calculated confidence interval boundaries for the train front end position.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is located 15m (10m + 5m) in rear of the estimated front end. The max safe front end is located 15m (10m + 5m) in advance of the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5. LRBG is BG-A with location accuracy 10m. Odometer over-reading is 5m, under-reading is 5m. Consist length uncertainty is 2m.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the min safe front end and max safe front end positions relative to the estimated front end.

steps.action: Observe the calculated confidence interval boundaries for the train front end position.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is located 17m (10m + 5m + 2m) in rear of the estimated front end. The max safe front end is located 17m (10m + 5m + 2m) in advance of the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information announces BG-A and BG-B. BG-A is the reference of the linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the current SOLR.

steps.action: Detect BG-A.
steps.expected: The SOLR is set to BG-A.

steps.action: Detect BG-B.
steps.expected: The SOLR is updated to BG-B, as it is the most recently received balise group announced in linking information.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the current SOLR.

steps.action: Detect BG-C.
steps.expected: The SOLR is set to BG-C.

steps.action: Detect BG-D.
steps.expected: The SOLR is updated to BG-D, as it is the last received balise group.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with ID 'unknown' and repositioning info
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information announces a balise group with ID 'unknown' that contains repositioning information.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the current SOLR.

steps.action: Detect the balise group with ID 'unknown' containing repositioning information.
steps.expected: The SOLR is set to this balise group, as it is announced in linking information and carries repositioning information.

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored linking information. A new linking information is received that changes the reference balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the SOLR and the internal state of linking information.

steps.action: Receive new linking information that triggers a replacement of the stored linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule (SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m)) first, then updates the SOLR based on the new linking information.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement rule for non-linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has location based information referred to a balise group other than the current SOLR. A new piece of information (not linking) is received that requires relocation.
test_cases.test_inputs: New location based information.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the location items and the SOLR.

steps.action: Receive new location based information that is referred to a balise group other than the current SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the SOLR before applying the corresponding replacement rule of §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into three items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A location based information item is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: A location based information item with a single distance value.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the internal location items (min, estimated, max).

steps.action: Receive a location based information item.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the information into three location items: 'min', 'estimated', and 'max'.

test_cases.title: Applying clause with corresponding location item
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A location based information item is received. SUBSET-026 Table 2a associates a specific clause with the 'min' location item for this information type.
test_cases.test_inputs: A location based information item.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the internal location items and the application of clauses.

steps.action: Receive a location based information item for which Table 2a specifies the use of the 'min' location item.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the associated clause using the 'min' location item.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items when new SOLR is established
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has location based information referred to BG-A (current SOLR). BG-B is detected and becomes the new SOLR. The distance between BG-A and BG-B is 100m.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the location items and the SOLR.

steps.action: Detect BG-B and establish it as the new SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates every location item to the new SOLR (BG-B) by subtracting the distance between BG-A and BG-B (100m) from the distance of each location item.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items when evaluating information referred to non-SOLR
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has location based information referred to BG-C, while the current SOLR is BG-A. The distance between BG-C and BG-A is 50m.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the location items and the SOLR.

steps.action: Evaluate the location based information referred to BG-C.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location items to the SOLR (BG-A) by subtracting the distance between BG-C and BG-A (50m) from the distance of each location item.

test_cases.title: Position report on reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. RBC has sent position report parameters. Train is moving.

steps.action: Decelerate the train until it reaches standstill (speed = 0).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the event of reaching standstill (e.g., speed is 0, position is updated).

test_cases.title: Position report on leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. RBC has sent position report parameters. Train is at standstill.

steps.action: Accelerate the train from standstill to a non-zero speed.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the event of leaving standstill (e.g., speed > 0, position is updated).

test_cases.title: Position report on mode change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a valid operational mode (e.g., Full Supervision). RBC has sent position report parameters.

steps.action: Trigger a mode change (e.g., from Full Supervision to Shunting).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the new mode.

test_cases.title: Position report on level change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. RBC has sent position report parameters.

steps.action: Trigger a level change (e.g., from Level 2 to Level 1).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the new level.

test_cases.title: Position report on successful session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is not connected to an RBC. RBC is available.

steps.action: Establish a communication session with the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC upon successful session establishment.

test_cases.title: Position report on passing LRBG without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has no position report parameters stored on-board. Train is moving towards an LRBG compliant balise group.

steps.action: Pass the LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on RBC/RBC border crossing (min safe rear end)
test_cases.preconditions: Train is approaching an RBC/RBC border. Position reporting is active.

steps.action: Move the train such that its min safe rear end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on RBC/RBC border crossing (max safe front end)
test_cases.preconditions: Train is approaching an RBC/RBC border. Position reporting is active.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity confirmed by driver
test_cases.preconditions: Train is at standstill. Train position is valid and referred to an LRBG. Valid Train Data is available. Current integrity status is 'No train integrity information'.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the train integrity status to 'Train integrity confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by leaving standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'Train integrity confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity confirmed by external source
test_cases.preconditions: Train position is valid and referred to an LRBG. Valid Train Data is available. Current integrity status is 'No train integrity information'.

steps.action: Receive train integrity confirmation from an external source.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the train integrity status to 'Train integrity confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'Train integrity confirmed by external source' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity lost
test_cases.preconditions: Current integrity status is 'Train integrity confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Detect loss of train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the train integrity status to 'Train integrity lost'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'Train integrity lost' and does NOT contain confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Report no train integrity information
test_cases.preconditions: Current integrity status is 'No train integrity information'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'No train integrity information' and does NOT contain confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Integrity to Confirmed by Driver
test_cases.preconditions: Current integrity status is 'No train integrity information'. Train is at standstill. Position is valid and referred to LRBG. Train length is available.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The integrity status transitions to 'Train integrity confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Integrity to Confirmed by External Source
test_cases.preconditions: Current integrity status is 'No train integrity information'. Position is valid and referred to LRBG. Train length is available.

steps.action: Receive integrity confirmation from external source.
steps.expected: The integrity status transitions to 'Train integrity confirmed by external source'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Confirmed to Integrity Lost
test_cases.preconditions: Current integrity status is 'Train integrity confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Detect loss of train integrity.
steps.expected: The integrity status transitions to 'Train integrity lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Integrity Lost to No Integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Current integrity status is 'Train integrity lost'.
test_cases.assumptions: Assume that a reset or specific condition allows transition back to 'No integrity information' as per Table 2b/2c logic (e.g., after a certain time or reset).

steps.action: Reset the integrity status or wait for the condition that allows transition to 'No integrity information'.
steps.expected: The integrity status transitions to 'No train integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Invalid transition attempt: Confirmed to Confirmed (different source)
test_cases.preconditions: Current integrity status is 'Train integrity confirmed by driver'.
test_cases.assumptions: Table 2b does not allow direct transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Confirmed by external source' without going through 'Lost' or 'No Integrity' first, or it is not a valid direct transition.

steps.action: Receive integrity confirmation from external source while status is 'Confirmed by driver'.
steps.expected: The integrity status does NOT change to 'Confirmed by external source' directly if not allowed by Table 2b. It remains 'Confirmed by driver' or follows the specific transition rule (e.g., stays same or goes to lost if conflict). *Note: Based on typical ETCS logic, if already confirmed, a new confirmation might just update the source or be ignored depending on specific table rules. Assuming strict adherence to Table 2b, if direct transition is not defined, it should not happen.*

test_cases.title: Geographical position display upon driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has valid geographical position data available.

steps.action: Verify the initial state of the geographical position display area.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not displayed.

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position (e.g., via touch screen or soft key).
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the train's estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stopping geographical position display upon driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position is currently being displayed on the OBU.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a valid geographical reference location (balise group) and is moving.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly measures the distance travelled since the last geographical reference.

steps.action: Record the geographical position at the geographical reference location (distance travelled = 0).
steps.expected: The displayed geographical position corresponds to the track kilometre reference value.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance (e.g., 100 meters) from the geographical reference location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and displays a new geographical position that is the sum of the track kilometre reference value and the distance travelled (100 meters).

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where Roll Away Protection supervision can be started (e.g., Standstill). The National Value for maximum roll-away distance is set to 10 m. The train is stationary at a known location L0.
test_cases.test_inputs: National Value for roll-away distance: 10 m. Initial train position: L0.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for test observation.

steps.action: Start the Roll Away Protection supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and displays the remaining distance as 10 m (the full National Value) relative to the start location L0.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 2 m (simulated via odometer input).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 8 m (10 m - 2 m).

test_cases.title: Post Trip reversing distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Post Trip mode. The National Value for maximum reversing distance is set to 5 m. The train is stationary at location L1.
test_cases.test_inputs: National Value for reversing distance: 5 m. Initial train position: L1.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for test observation.

steps.action: Start the Post Trip reversing supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and displays the remaining distance as 5 m relative to the start location L1.

steps.action: Move the train in the reversing direction by 1 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 4 m (5 m - 1 m).

test_cases.title: Trip suppression distance supervision after Override
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where Override can be triggered. The National Value for trip suppression distance is set to 20 m. The train is at location L2.
test_cases.test_inputs: National Value for trip suppression distance: 20 m. Initial train position: L2.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for test observation.

steps.action: Trigger the Override function.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the trip suppression distance supervision and calculates the remaining distance as 20 m relative to the location at the time of Override.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 15 m (20 m - 5 m).

test_cases.title: Supervision restart resets distance calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Roll Away Protection supervision is active. The train has moved 3 m from the initial start location. The National Value is 10 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: National Value for roll-away distance: 10 m. Current remaining distance: 7 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows restarting the supervision (e.g., via a specific command or state change that triggers re-start).

steps.action: Trigger a re-start of the Roll Away Protection supervision at the current location.
steps.expected: The OBU resets the reference location to the current position and recalculates the remaining distance as 10 m (the full National Value).

steps.action: Move the train forward by 1 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 9 m (10 m - 1 m), confirming the new reference point.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position for Staff Responsible mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The maximum permitted distance is set to 100 m. The train is at a location without valid balise position (virtual position used). Odometer under-reading is 0 m, over-reading is 0 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR maximum distance: 100 m. Odometer under/over-reading: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the estimated, min safe, and max safe front end positions or the derived remaining distances.

steps.action: Start the SR distance supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU creates a virtual train front position. The remaining distance for the estimated front end is 100 m. The remaining distance for the min safe front end is 100 m. The remaining distance for the max safe front end is 100 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 10 m. Simulate an odometer under-reading of 2 m and over-reading of 2 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distances: Estimated: 90 m (100 - 10). Min safe: 92 m (100 - 10 + 2). Max safe: 88 m (100 - 10 - 2).

test_cases.title: Virtual position update on SR distance change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. Current SR distance is 100 m. Train has moved 20 m from the start of supervision. Odometer errors are 0 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: New SR distance: 150 m. Current travelled distance: 20 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance.

steps.action: Update the SR maximum distance to 150 m via RBC or driver input.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as a re-start of supervision. It deletes the previous virtual position and creates a new one at the current location. The remaining distance is recalculated as 150 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 145 m (150 m - 5 m).

test_cases.title: Virtual position re-evaluation on National Value change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. Current SR distance is 100 m. Train has moved 20 m from the start of supervision. Odometer errors are 0 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: New National Value for SR distance: 120 m. Current travelled distance: 20 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance.

steps.action: Receive a new National Value for the SR distance of 120 m.
steps.expected: The OBU re-evaluates the virtual train position using the new National Value. The remaining distance is recalculated as 100 m (120 m - 20 m travelled).

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 95 m (100 m - 5 m).

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP ve eğim MA uzunluğunu kapsamıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2 modunda çalışmaktadır. RBC'den gelen MA, non-infill tipindedir. OBU'da mevcut SSP ve eğim verileri, trenin tahmini ön ucundan denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi kapsamamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA mesajı (SSP/eğim eksik).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön ucu ve denetlenen konum (supervised location) konumları OBU tarafından doğru olarak hesaplanmıştır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve eğim verileri MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamayan bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profilini (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mod profili geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı incelenir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'nın reddedildiğini RBC'ye bildirir.

test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA mesajı (SSP/eğim eksik, infill).
test_cases.assumptions: Infill konum referans noktası ve denetlenen konum (supervised location) konumları OBU tarafından doğru olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve eğim verileri MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (infill konum referansından denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamayan bir infill MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profilini (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mod profili geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı incelenir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'nın reddedildiğini RBC'ye bildirir.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP ve eğim MA uzunluğunu kapsamıyor (Supervised Manoeuvre, ters yön)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Supervised Manoeuvre (SM) yetkisi kapsamında çalışmaktadır. Gelen MA'nın geçerlilik yönü, trenin mevcut yöneliminin tersidir. steps.action: RBC'den, geçerlilik yönü trenin mevcut yöneliminin tersi olan ve SSP/eğim verileri yeni yönelime göre tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar kapsamayan bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profilini (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mod profili geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmesi: SSP ve eğim MA uzunluğunu tam olarak kapsıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2 modunda çalışmaktadır. RBC'den gelen MA, non-infill tipindedir. OBU'da mevcut SSP ve eğim verileri, trenin tahmini ön ucundan denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA mesajı (SSP/eğim tam).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön ucu ve denetlenen konum (supervised location) konumları OBU tarafından doğru olarak hesaplanmıştır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve eğim verileri MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsayan bir MA mesajı gönderilir.

test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2 modunda çalışmaktadır. RBC'den gelen MA, non-infill tipindedir. OBU'da mevcut SSP ve eğim verileri, trenin tahmini ön ucundan denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafenin 1 metre kısa bir kısmını kapsamaktadır.

test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön ucu ve denetlenen konum (supervised location) konumları OBU tarafından doğru olarak hesaplanmıştır.
