test_cases.title: Static Speed Profile replacement from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren eski bir Static Speed Profile (SSP) bilgisi depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir SSP paketi, başlangıç konumu eski SSP'nin başlangıç konumundan ileriye doğru olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeni SSP'nin başlangıç konumu, eski SSP'nin başlangıç konumundan sonra bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Yeni Static Speed Profile bilgisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni SSP'nin başlangıç konumundan itibaren tüm depolanan SSP bilgilerini yeni bilgilerle değiştirir. Başlangıç konumundan önceki SSP bilgileri korunur.

test_cases.title: Gradient Profile replacement from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren eski bir Gradient Profile (GP) bilgisi depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir GP paketi, başlangıç konumu eski GP'nin başlangıç konumundan ileriye doğru olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeni GP'nin başlangıç konumu, eski GP'nin başlangıç konumundan sonra bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Yeni Gradient Profile bilgisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni GP'nin başlangıç konumundan itibaren tüm depolanan GP bilgilerini yeni bilgilerle değiştirir. Başlangıç konumundan önceki GP bilgileri korunur.

test_cases.title: Axle Load Speed Profile replacement from first element start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren eski bir Axle Load Speed Profile (ALSP) bilgisi depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir ALSP paketi, ilk elemanının başlangıç konumu eski ALSP'nin başlangıç konumundan ileriye doğru olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeni ALSP'nin ilk elemanının başlangıç konumu, eski ALSP'nin başlangıç konumundan sonra bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Yeni Axle Load Speed Profile bilgisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni ALSP'nin ilk elemanının başlangıç konumundan itibaren tüm depolanan ALSP bilgilerini yeni bilgilerle değiştirir. Başlangıç konumundan önceki ALSP bilgileri korunur.

test_cases.title: Route Suitability Loading Gauge complete replacement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, mevcut Route Suitability Loading Gauge bilgisi depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir Route Suitability Loading Gauge paketi gönderilir.

steps.action: Yeni Route Suitability Loading Gauge bilgisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, tüm depolanan Route Suitability Loading Gauge bilgilerini yeni bilgilerle tamamen değiştirir.

test_cases.title: Linking Information replacement from reference balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir referans balise grubundan itibaren eski bir Linking Information (LI) depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir non-infill Linking Information paketi, referans balise grubu eski LI'nin referans balise grubundan ileriye doğru olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeni LI'nin referans balise grubu, eski LI'nin referans balise grubundan sonra bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Yeni non-infill Linking Information OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni LI'nin referans balise grubundan itibaren tüm depolanan LI bilgilerini yeni bilgilerle değiştirir. Referans balise grubundan önceki LI bilgileri korunur.

test_cases.title: Infill Linking Information replacement from infill reference location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren eski bir Linking Information (LI) depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir infill Linking Information paketi, infill referans konumu (sonraki ana sinyaldeki balise grubu) eski LI'nin referans konumundan ileriye doğru olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeni infill LI'nin referans konumu, eski LI'nin referans konumundan sonra bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Yeni infill Linking Information OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni infill LI'nin referans konumundan itibaren tüm depolanan LI bilgilerini yeni bilgilerle değiştirir. Referans konumundan önceki LI bilgileri korunur.

test_cases.title: Resumption of PBD speed restrictions beyond a location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren PBD hız kısıtlamaları depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside, belirli bir konumun ötesinde PBD hız kısıtlamalarının başlangıç durumuna dönmesini talep eder.
test_cases.assumptions: Talep edilen konum, mevcut depolanan PBD hız kısıtlamalarının başlangıç konumundan sonra bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Trackside, PBD hız kısıtlamaları için başlangıç durumuna dönme talebini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, talep edilen konumun ötesindeki PBD hız kısıtlamalarını başlangıç durumuna döndürür. Talep edilen konumdan önceki PBD hız kısıtlamaları korunur.

test_cases.title: Resumption of Axle Load Speed Profiles beyond a location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren Axle Load Speed Profile (ALSP) bilgileri depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside, belirli bir konumun ötesinde ALSP'lerin başlangıç durumuna dönmesini talep eder.
test_cases.assumptions: Talep edilen konum, mevcut depolanan ALSP'lerin başlangıç konumundan sonra bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Trackside, Axle Load Speed Profile'ler için başlangıç durumuna dönme talebini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, talep edilen konumun ötesindeki ALSP'leri başlangıç durumuna döndürür. Talep edilen konumdan önceki ALSP'ler korunur.

test_cases.title: Resumption of Track Condition types beyond a location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren Track Condition bilgileri (örneğin, sound horn, tunnel stopping area) depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside, belirli bir konumun ötesinde Track Condition tiplerinin başlangıç durumuna dönmesini talep eder.
test_cases.assumptions: Talep edilen konum, mevcut depolanan Track Condition bilgilerinin başlangıç konumundan sonra bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Trackside, Track Condition tipleri için başlangıç durumuna dönme talebini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, talep edilen konumun ötesindeki Track Condition bilgilerini başlangıç durumuna döndürür. Talep edilen konumdan önceki Track Condition bilgileri korunur.

test_cases.title: Resumption of Route Suitability data beyond a location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Route Suitability verileri (örneğin, loading gauge, traction system) depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside, Route Suitability verilerinin başlangıç durumuna dönmesini talep eder.

steps.action: Trackside, Route Suitability verileri için başlangıç durumuna dönme talebini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, tüm Route Suitability verilerini başlangıç durumuna döndürür.

test_cases.title: Resumption of Station Platform track conditions beyond a location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren Station Platform track condition bilgileri depolamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside, belirli bir konumun ötesinde Station Platform track condition'ların başlangıç durumuna dönmesini talep eder.
test_cases.assumptions: Talep edilen konum, mevcut depolanan Station Platform bilgilerinin başlangıç konumundan sonra bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: Trackside, Station Platform track condition'lar için başlangıç durumuna dönme talebini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, talep edilen konumun ötesindeki Station Platform track condition'ları başlangıç durumuna döndürür. Talep edilen konumdan önceki Station Platform bilgileri korunur.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with matching validity direction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren location based information depolamaktadır. Trenin mevcut yönü ileriye doğrudur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerlilik yönü ileriye doğru olan bir Supervised Manoeuvre yetkisi gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin mevcut yönü ileriye doğrudur ve yetkinin geçerlilik yönü de ileriye doğrudur.

steps.action: Geçerlilik yönü trenin mevcut yönüyle eşleşen bir Supervised Manoeuvre yetkisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1'de belirtilen normal değiştirme kurallarını uygular. Depolanan location based information, yeni yetkinin içeriğine göre güncellenir.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite validity direction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, belirli bir konumdan itibaren location based information depolamaktadır. Trenin mevcut yönü ileriye doğrudur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerlilik yönü geriye doğru olan bir Supervised Manoeuvre yetkisi gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin mevcut yönü ileriye doğrudur ve yetkinin geçerlilik yönü geriye doğrudur.

steps.action: Geçerlilik yönü trenin mevcut yönünün tersi olan bir Supervised Manoeuvre yetkisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, normal değiştirme kurallarını uygulamaz. Bunun yerine, daha önce depolanan tüm location based information'ı siler.

test_cases.title: MA request includes single applicable reason
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. RBC has sent MA request parameters. Only one MA request reason is currently applicable (e.g., 'Start' selection by driver).
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver selects 'Start'.

steps.action: Driver performs 'Start' selection.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'Start' and no other reasons.

test_cases.title: MA request includes multiple applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. RBC has sent MA request parameters. Two MA request reasons are simultaneously applicable (e.g., 'Start' selection and 'Track description deletion').
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver selects 'Start' while a track description deletion event is active.

steps.action: Trigger the MA request (e.g., via 'Start' selection).
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains both reasons: 'Start' and 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by passing perturbation location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. RBC has sent MA request parameters defining the perturbation location criterion. The train is running at warning speed towards the perturbation location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward to pass the calculated trigger location.

steps.action: Move the train front past the location defined by the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason related to the perturbation location.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer expiry
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. RBC has sent MA request parameters defining the Section timer criterion. The Section timer for the current MA section is running.
test_cases.test_inputs: Wait for the Section timer to reach the defined trigger moment.

steps.action: Allow the Section timer to reach the moment defined by the criterion.
steps.expected: OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason related to the MA timer elapsing.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion (valid situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid track description is stored. The deletion scenario corresponds to a situation in Appendix A.3.4 that is NOT a, b, f, or k (e.g., situation c).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger a track description deletion event corresponding to a valid situation (e.g., situation c).

steps.action: Cause a part of the track description to be deleted according to a valid situation (e.g., situation c).
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: No MA request triggered by track description deletion (excluded situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid track description is stored. The deletion scenario corresponds to one of the excluded situations a, b, f, or k in Appendix A.3.4 (e.g., situation a).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger a track description deletion event corresponding to an excluded situation (e.g., situation a).

steps.action: Cause a part of the track description to be deleted according to an excluded situation (e.g., situation a).
steps.expected: OBU does NOT send an MA request to the RBC solely due to this deletion.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an End Section timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing End Section timer start location and time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts running on the OBU.

test_cases.title: End Section time-out consequences: LOA withdrawal and speed zeroing
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The current MA is an LOA with a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving within the MA.

steps.action: Allow the End Section timer to exceed the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the train's current position. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with a specific time stamp.

steps.action: Receive the MA message in Level 2.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the value of the time stamp of the message containing the MA.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train approaches a balise group giving the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group with MA information.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passage over the first encountered balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed time-out consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. The current MA is an LOA with a non-zero speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Wait for the LOA speed timer to exceed the time-out value.

steps.action: Allow the LOA speed timer to exceed the time-out value received from trackside.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA with the SvL defined as per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and time-out value.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts running on the OBU.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train and an 'infinite' time-out value is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and 'infinite' time-out value.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is regarded as started on the OBU.

test_cases.title: Overlap time-out consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The current MA includes an overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: Wait for the Overlap timer to exceed the time-out value.

steps.action: Allow the Overlap timer to exceed the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The overlap and its associated release speed are deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5 (deleting information per Appendix A.3.4). Any non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bring the train to a standstill.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill after the Overlap timer has been started.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired and applies the consequences defined for Overlap time-out in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 (deletion of overlap, redetermination of SvL, zeroing of target speed).

test_cases.title: New MA with Overlap start location in rear of train (no timer running)
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is running. The train is positioned such that its max safe front end is ahead of the Overlap timer start location in the new MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end.

steps.action: Receive a new MA with an Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end of the train.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer has exceeded its time-out value and applies SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 (deletion of overlap, redetermination of SvL, zeroing of target speed).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with valid overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The MA includes an overlap that has not timed out. A Danger Point and End Section are also defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with valid overlap, Danger Point, and End Section.

steps.action: Evaluate the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the end of the overlap as the Supervised Location.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with timed-out overlap and valid Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The overlap has timed out. A Danger Point is defined. An End Section is also defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with timed-out overlap, valid Danger Point, and End Section.

steps.action: Evaluate the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the Danger Point as the Supervised Location.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap and no Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: No overlap exists (or it has timed out). No Danger Point exists. An End Section is defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with no valid overlap, no Danger Point, and valid End Section.

steps.action: Evaluate the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the end of the End Section as the Supervised Location.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Full Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Automatic Driving mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Automatic Driving mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Automatic Driving mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Limited Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Limited Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Limited Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection in non-permitted modes
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode other than Full Supervision, Automatic Driving, or Limited Supervision (e.g., Supervision mode or Standstill).
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in a non-permitted mode.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message referring to a main signal balise group with available linking information.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA with available linking information for the referenced main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is NOT available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message referring to a main signal balise group without available linking information.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA without available linking information for the referenced main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Replacement of MA data from RBC (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA received from a main signal balise group. The train is moving within the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message from the RBC with different data (e.g., different SvL, different speed restrictions) than the currently stored MA.

steps.action: Transmit a new MA from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (including data before the next main signal) has been replaced by the new data from the RBC.

test_cases.title: Replacement of MA data from Main Signal Balise (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA. The train is approaching a main signal with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message at the main signal containing a new MA (non-infill) with different data than the currently stored MA.

steps.action: Pass the main signal balise group containing the new MA.
steps.expected: The OBU reads the balise group message.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA has been replaced by the new data from the balise group.

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of MA data from Infill Balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA. Linking information for the next main signal balise group is available. The train is approaching an infill balise group located before the next main signal.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message from a balise group. The infill MA contains data for the section beyond the next main signal that differs from the currently stored data. The data for the section up to the next main signal remains the same.

steps.action: Pass the infill balise group containing the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU reads the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data for the section up to the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for the section up to the next main signal remains unchanged from the previous MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data for the section beyond the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for the section beyond the next main signal has been replaced by the new data from the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Start of new MA section at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA. Linking information for the next main signal balise group is available. The train is approaching an infill balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message from a balise group.

steps.action: Pass the infill balise group containing the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the MA section structure in the OBU.
steps.expected: A new MA section starts at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal.

test_cases.title: MA shortening when SvL replaces LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an MA ending with an LOA (Limit of Authority). Location based information is stored on-board as per Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA from the RBC or a main signal balise group defining an SvL (Stop Location) at any location.

steps.action: Transmit the new MA defining an SvL to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU status regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the reception as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Inspect the stored location based information.
steps.expected: The location based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 that is beyond the new SvL has been deleted.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information is not MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA. Linking information has announced a following balise group as unknown but containing repositioning information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message containing repositioning information.

steps.action: Pass the balise group containing the repositioning information.
steps.expected: The OBU reads the repositioning information.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU status regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat the reception as an MA shortening.

test_cases.title: New MA with LOA is not MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA ending with an SvL.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA from the RBC or a main signal balise group ending with an LOA.

steps.action: Transmit the new MA ending with an LOA to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU status regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat the reception as an MA shortening.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (Tren ISL'nin arkasında)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ile Level 2 modunda çalışmaktadır. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği mesajı (önerilen EOA, mevcut EOA'dan daha yakın; opsiyonel mod profili ve SH alanı balise listesi).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucunun konumu, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit (I) değerinin arkasındadır.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, trenin ön ucunun önerilen MA'nın İndication supervision limit değerinin arkasında olduğunu doğrular.

steps.action: OBU'nun iç durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı, varsa mod profilini ve SH alanı balise grup listesini yeni geçerli MA olarak kabul eder ve depolar.

steps.action: OBU'dan RBC'ye gönderilen yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.test_inputs: Duyuru balise grubu: Infill ortamı olarak 'Radio Infill' veya 'Euroloop' talep eden, ancak OBU'nun donanımında bulunmayan bir ortamı işaret eden bir balise grubu.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun donanım konfigürasyonu, infill ortamlarını desteklemediğini doğrulanmıştır.

steps.expected: OBU, duyuru bilgisini yok sayar. Hata alarmı vermez ve mevcut hareket iznini (MA) iptal etmez.

steps.expected: Tren, mevcut hareket izni sınırları içinde normal hızda ilerlemeye devam eder. Infill bağlantısı kurulmaz.

test_cases.title: Desteklenmeyen infill ortamı talebinde mevcut durumun korunması (Sınır)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 1 modundadır. OBU, Euroloop donanımına sahip değildir. OBU, bir sonraki ana sinyal balise grubuna yaklaşıyor ve mevcut MA bu sinyale kadar geçerlidir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Duyuru balise grubu: 'Euroloop' infill ortamını talep eden bir balise grubu.

steps.expected: OBU, Euroloop donanımı olmadığı için talebi yok sayar. Mevcut MA geçerliliğini korur.

steps.expected: OBU, ana sinyal balise grubundaki bilgilere göre yeni MA'yı hesaplar ve uygular. Infill süreci devreye girmez.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores loop infill after reading next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 operation. A loop infill area is active and transmitting infill information for the next main signal balise group (NMBG). The OBU has not yet read the NMBG.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill data stream containing valid infill information for the NMBG.
test_cases.assumptions: The loop infill unit continues to transmit data even after the OBU reads the NMBG, to verify the OBU's filtering behavior.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU reading the next main signal balise group (NMBG).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the balise data and updates its internal state to reflect that the NMBG has been read.

steps.action: Transmit new infill information from the loop related to the previously read NMBG.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information. No changes are made to the movement authority or infill status based on this data.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores loop infill after detecting missed next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 operation. A loop infill area is active and transmitting infill information for the next main signal balise group (NMBG). The OBU has not yet read the NMBG.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill data stream containing valid infill information for the NMBG.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's detection logic for a missed balise group is triggered by passing the expected position without reading the balise.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU passing the expected position of the next main signal balise group without reading it, triggering the 'missed balise' detection.
steps.expected: The OBU detects that the NMBG was missed and updates its internal state accordingly.

steps.action: Transmit new infill information from the loop related to the missed NMBG.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information. No changes are made to the movement authority or infill status based on this data.

test_cases.title: GSM-R not installed: Order to establish session is ignored
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured without GSM-R radio system. OBU is in Level 1.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with RIU-1.

steps.action: Pass the balise group containing the order to establish a session with RIU-1.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to establish a communication session with RIU-1. No GSM-R connection is initiated.

test_cases.title: Balise order: Terminate other RIU session and establish new one
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 with GSM-R installed. An active communication session with RIU-A exists. OBU is approaching the location specified in a new balise order for RIU-B.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group containing an order to establish a session with RIU-B at location L.
test_cases.assumptions: RIU-A and RIU-B are distinct units. The OBU is capable of handling the new session.

steps.action: Pass the balise group containing the order for RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the order and the target location L.

steps.action: Reach the location L specified in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing communication session with RIU-A.

steps.action: Wait for the OBU to be ready to handle a new session.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a communication session with RIU-B.

test_cases.title: Degraded mode (1 session max): RIU order to establish new session is ignored
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 with GSM-R installed. OBU is in a degraded situation where it can handle only one GSM-R communication session. An active session with RIU-A exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Message from RIU-A (or another RIU) containing an order to establish a session with RIU-B.
test_cases.assumptions: The order is received via the existing GSM-R link from a Radio Infill Unit.

steps.action: Receive an order via the active RIU session to establish a new session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order. The session with RIU-A remains active. No new session with RIU-B is established.

test_cases.title: Send info to RIU upon entering infill area and upon reading NMBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A communication session with RIU-1 is established. The balise order specified location L_entry and NMBG ID.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing L_entry and then passing the NMBG.

steps.action: Pass the location L_entry specified in the balise order.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to RIU-1 indicating entry into the infill area.

steps.action: Pass the Next Main Signal Balise Group (NMBG) indicated in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to RIU-1 indicating that the NMBG has been read.

test_cases.title: Send info to RIU upon detecting missed NMBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A communication session with RIU-1 is established. The balise order specified location L_entry and NMBG ID.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing L_entry but failing to read the NMBG (e.g., due to signal loss or physical obstruction).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to detect that the expected NMBG was missed (e.g., timeout or position mismatch).

steps.action: Pass the location L_entry specified in the balise order.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to RIU-1 indicating entry into the infill area.

steps.action: Trigger the detection of the missed NMBG.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to RIU-1 indicating that the NMBG was missed.

test_cases.title: Verify content of information sent to RIU
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A communication session with RIU-1 is established. OBU has a valid ETCS-ID and current position.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for sending information (e.g., passing L_entry).
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment can capture and decode the GSM-R messages sent by the OBU.

steps.action: Trigger the OBU to send information to RIU-1 (e.g., by passing the infill area entry location).
steps.expected: The captured message contains the OBU's ETCS-ID.

steps.action: Inspect the captured message.
steps.expected: The message contains a position report consistent with the OBU's current location.

steps.action: Inspect the captured message.
steps.expected: The message contains the identifier of the Next Main Signal Balise Group (NMBG) from the active order.

steps.action: Inspect the captured message.
steps.expected: The message contains a valid time stamp.

test_cases.title: Check consistency of received radio infill data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A communication session with RIU-1 is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio infill data with an inconsistent time stamp (e.g., future time or invalid format) as per SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1/3.16.3.3.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment can inject specific radio infill data messages.

steps.action: Inject radio infill data with an inconsistent time stamp.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data or flags it as inconsistent. The data is not used for movement authority or speed calculation.

test_cases.title: Ignore further infill info after reading NMBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A communication session with RIU-1 is established. The OBU has just read the NMBG indicated in the order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Additional radio infill messages related to the same NMBG.

steps.action: Read the NMBG indicated in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the NMBG read event.

steps.action: Receive further radio infill information related to that NMBG.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the further information. It does not update its state based on this data.

test_cases.title: Terminate RIU session upon leaving Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. An active communication session with RIU-1 exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to switch to Level 2 (or another level where RIU is not used).

steps.action: Initiate a transition from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with RIU-1.

test_cases.title: Terminate RIU session upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. An active communication session with RIU-1 exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group or RIU message containing an order to terminate the communication session.

steps.action: Receive an order to terminate the communication session from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with RIU-1.

test_cases.title: Emergency message acknowledgement with correct ID
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid Unconditional Emergency Stop message (Message 16) with a unique NID_EM value.

steps.action: Send an Unconditional Emergency Stop message (Message 16) to the OBU with a specific NID_EM value.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and processes it.

steps.action: Monitor the radio transmission from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU transmits an Acknowledgement of Emergency Stop message (Message 147) containing the same NID_EM value as the received message.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of repeated emergency message with same ID
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has already received and acknowledged an emergency message with NID_EM = X.
test_cases.test_inputs: A repeated Unconditional Emergency Stop message (Message 16) with the same NID_EM value (X).

steps.action: Send a repeated Unconditional Emergency Stop message (Message 16) to the OBU with the same NID_EM value as the previous message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Monitor the radio transmission from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU transmits an Acknowledgement of Emergency Stop message (Message 147) containing the NID_EM value X.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of new emergency message with different ID
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has already received and acknowledged an emergency message with NID_EM = X.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new Unconditional Emergency Stop message (Message 16) with a different NID_EM value (Y).

steps.action: Send a new Unconditional Emergency Stop message (Message 16) to the OBU with a different NID_EM value (Y).
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and replaces the previous emergency message context.

steps.action: Monitor the radio transmission from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU transmits an Acknowledgement of Emergency Stop message (Message 147) containing the new NID_EM value Y.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop aktifken yeni hareket yetkisinin reddedilmesi

steps.expected: OBU yeni hareket yetkisini reddeder. Tren durdurulmuş kalır ve hareket yetkisi güncellenmez.

test_cases.title: Revocation of emergency message acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it can receive and process trackside messages (e.g., Full Supervision). An emergency message with a specific identifier has been previously received and acknowledged by the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message for the previously received emergency message, containing the corresponding identifier and a request for acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio communication link between the RBC and the OBU is stable and functional.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for the existing emergency message from the trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message and identifies the emergency message to be revoked based on the identifier.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's response to the revocation message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the trackside. The acknowledgement message refers to the time stamp of the revocation message sent by the trackside, in accordance with SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.

test_cases.title: Revocation of non-existent emergency message
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it can receive and process trackside messages. No emergency message with the identifier specified in the revocation message has been received by the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message for an emergency message identifier that does not exist in the OBU's memory, containing a request for acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU handles unknown identifiers according to standard error handling procedures for inconsistent or unexpected messages, but still acknowledges the receipt of the revocation command if the message structure is valid.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for an emergency message identifier that the OBU has not received.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the message. Since the message is not considered inconsistent in terms of format (it is a valid revocation request), the OBU shall send an acknowledgement to the trackside as per the general acknowledgement procedure.

steps.action: Verify the content of the acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The acknowledgement message refers to the time stamp of the revocation message.

test_cases.assumptions: Hesaplama, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki eşitsizlikleri ve yuvarlama kuralını uygular.

steps.action: OBU, acil frenleme senaryosu için PBD hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar.
steps.expected: Hesaplanan hız, EBD eğrisine dayalı eşitsizlikleri sağlar ve 5 km/h'nin tam katlarına aşağı yuvarlanır.

test_cases.title: Servis freni için PBD hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, servis freni ile PBD'ye ulaşılmasını gerektiren bir profil alır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Servis freni tipi, geçerli PBD mesafesi, eğim.
test_cases.assumptions: Hesaplama, EBD ve SBD eğrilerini dikkate alır ve en kısıtlayıcı değeri seçer.

steps.action: OBU, servis freni senaryosu için PBD hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar.
steps.expected: Hesaplanan hız, EBD ve SBD tabanlı değerlerin en kısıtlayıcısıdır ve 5 km/h'nin tam katlarına aşağı yuvarlanır.

test_cases.title: Hiçbir hızın eşitsizlikleri sağlamaması durumunda sıfır hız
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, acil frenleme ile PBD'ye ulaşılmasını gerektiren bir profil alır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Çok kısa PBD mesafesi veya yüksek eğim gibi, eşitsizlikleri sağlayan bir hızın bulunmasını engelleyen girdiler.

steps.action: OBU, PBD hız kısıtlamasını hesaplar.
steps.expected: Hiçbir hız değeri eşitsizlikleri sağlamadığı için PBD hız kısıtlaması 0 olarak belirlenir.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start indication with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area track condition is received from trackside. The train is moving towards the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside data defining the start of a tunnel stopping area. Train speed and position data.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' position is distinct from the 'min safe' and 'max safe' front end positions in the test scenario.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the start location of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the start of the tunnel stopping area based on the estimated front end position and triggers the corresponding indication or state change.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area end indication with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The train is currently inside a tunnel stopping area. The OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside data defining the end of the tunnel stopping area. Train speed and position data.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' position is distinct from the 'min safe' and 'max safe' front end positions in the test scenario.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the end location of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end of the tunnel stopping area based on the estimated front end position and updates the state to indicate the train has left the area.

test_cases.title: Sound horn track condition start indication with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A sound horn track condition is received from trackside. The train is moving towards the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside data defining the start of a sound horn track condition. Train speed and position data.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' position is distinct from the 'min safe' and 'max safe' front end positions in the test scenario.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the start location of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the start of the sound horn track condition based on the estimated front end position and displays the 'Sound horn' indication.

test_cases.title: Sound horn track condition end indication with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The train is currently inside a sound horn track condition area. The 'Sound horn' indication is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside data defining the end of the sound horn track condition. Train speed and position data.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' position is distinct from the 'min safe' and 'max safe' front end positions in the test scenario.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the end location of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end of the sound horn track condition based on the estimated front end position and removes the 'Sound horn' indication.

test_cases.title: Loading gauge unsuitability detection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific loading gauge profile (e.g., 'G1').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of permitted loading gauges that does NOT include the train's configured loading gauge.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the permitted loading gauge list excludes the train's current loading gauge.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a loading gauge unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates that an unsuitability exists. The driver is informed about the loading gauge unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Axle load category unsuitability detection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific axle load category (e.g., 'A').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of permitted axle load categories that does NOT include the train's configured axle load category.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the permitted axle load category list excludes the train's current axle load category.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies an axle load category unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates that an unsuitability exists. The driver is informed about the axle load category unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Traction system unsuitability detection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific traction system (e.g., 'Electric 25kV'). The engine is NOT capable of running on a line without any traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a traction system that is NOT in the list of traction systems accepted by the engine.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside specifying a traction system that the engine does not accept.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a traction system unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates that an unsuitability exists. The driver is informed about the traction system unsuitability.

test_cases.title: No unsuitability when all parameters match
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with specific loading gauge, axle load category, and traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside where the permitted loading gauge list includes the train's gauge, the permitted axle load list includes the train's category, and the traction system matches the engine's accepted system.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where all parameters (loading gauge, axle load, traction system) are compatible with the stored Train Data.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and finds no unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status.
steps.expected: The OBU does not indicate any route suitability unsuitability. The train is permitted to run without restriction from this data.

test_cases.title: No traction unsuitability for engine capable of running without traction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured such that the engine is capable of running on a line without any traction system (e.g., diesel engine).
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside specifying a traction system that is NOT in the list of traction systems accepted by the engine (or no traction system specified).

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside specifying a traction system that the engine does not accept.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data. Despite the mismatch in traction system, it does NOT identify a traction system unsuitability because the engine can run without traction.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status regarding traction system.
steps.expected: The OBU does not indicate a traction system unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Operation without route suitability data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. No route suitability data has been received from trackside.

steps.action: Start the train and allow it to move without receiving any route suitability data from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to run. It does not apply any default route suitability restrictions.

steps.action: Check the OBU status for route suitability supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates that no route suitability restriction exists. It does not supervise any default values.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with class 'auxiliary information' and 'driver acknowledgement not requested'.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside with class 'auxiliary information' and no driver acknowledgement request.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for auxiliary information without acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with class 'important information' and 'driver acknowledgement requested'.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside with class 'important information' and driver acknowledgement requested.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message with the appearance defined for important information with acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled when ANY sub-condition is met (Q_TEXTDISPLAY=0)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with Q_TEXTDISPLAY=0 (OR logic) and two start sub-conditions: 'location' and 'speed'.

steps.action: Send a text message with Q_TEXTDISPLAY=0 and start sub-conditions 'location' and 'speed'.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the message and waits for start condition.

steps.action: Move the train to the specified location while speed is below the threshold.
steps.expected: The start condition is considered fulfilled because one sub-condition (location) is met. The message display starts.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled when ALL sub-conditions are met (Q_TEXTDISPLAY=1)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with Q_TEXTDISPLAY=1 (AND logic) and two start sub-conditions: 'location' and 'speed'.

steps.action: Send a text message with Q_TEXTDISPLAY=1 and start sub-conditions 'location' and 'speed'.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the message and waits for start condition.

steps.action: Move the train to the specified location while speed is below the threshold.
steps.expected: The start condition is NOT fulfilled. The message is not displayed.

steps.action: Increase train speed to meet the speed threshold while at the location.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled because all sub-conditions are met. The message display starts.

test_cases.title: Immediate start when no start sub-conditions are defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Send a text message with no start sub-conditions defined.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as immediately fulfilled and displays the message (assuming end condition is not immediately fulfilled).

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition (Option a)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message requesting driver confirmation, configured such that acknowledgement always ends display (Option a). End condition is not yet fulfilled.

steps.action: Send a text message requesting driver confirmation with Option a (acknowledgement ends display).
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before the end condition is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The text display ends immediately upon acknowledgement, even though the end condition is not fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement is necessary condition for ending display (Option b)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message requesting driver confirmation, configured such that acknowledgement is a necessary condition (Option b).

steps.action: Send a text message requesting driver confirmation with Option b (acknowledgement + end condition required).
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before the end condition is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The text display continues because the end condition is not yet fulfilled.

steps.action: Fulfil the end condition.
steps.expected: The text display ends because both acknowledgement and end condition are fulfilled.

test_cases.title: No display if end condition is immediately fulfilled
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message where the end condition is already fulfilled at the moment the start condition is fulfilled.

steps.action: Send a text message where the end condition is already fulfilled when the start condition becomes true.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message at all.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start condition including 'location' and end condition including 'location' with a specific length.

steps.action: Send a text message with start location L1 and end location L2 (L2 = L1 + length).
steps.expected: The message is displayed when the train reaches L1.

steps.action: Move the train from L1 to L2.
steps.expected: The message remains displayed until the train reaches L2, where the end condition is fulfilled and the display stops.

test_cases.title: Send driver acknowledgement report to RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message requesting a report of driver acknowledgement.

steps.action: Send a text message requesting a report of driver acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report to the RBC, including the text message identifier.

test_cases.title: Reject duplicate text message identifier
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a text message with identifier ID1 that has not been acknowledged.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new text message with the same identifier ID1.

steps.action: Receive a text message with identifier ID1 that is not yet acknowledged.
steps.expected: The message is stored and displayed.

steps.action: Receive a new text message with the same identifier ID1.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new text message.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile OS Mode Profile'ın kısmi silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir OS Mode Profile'ı denetlemektedir. Mode Profile başlangıcı (L_start) ve bitişi (L_end) tanımlıdır. Tren, L_start'ın arkasındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA, referans konumu (L_infill) L_start ve L_end arasında olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: L_infill, L_start'tan ileri ve L_end'den geride bir konumda kabul edilir.

steps.action: OBU'ya L_infill konumunda bir infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, L_infill konumundan itibaren (L_infill ve sonrası) OS Mode Profile'ı siler. L_start ile L_infill arasındaki bölümden kaynaklanan denetim devam eder.

steps.action: Tren, L_infill konumunu geçer.
steps.expected: L_infill konumundan itibaren Mode Profile'ın etkisi yoktur. OBU, yeni MA'daki diğer parametrelere göre denetim yapar.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile SH Mode Profile'ın silinmesi (Referans başlangıçta veya geride)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir SH Mode Profile'ı denetlemektedir. SH Mode Profile başlangıcı L_sh_start'tır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA, referans konumu (L_infill) L_sh_start ile aynı veya L_sh_start'ın gerisinde olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: L_infill <= L_sh_start koşulu sağlanır.

steps.action: OBU'ya L_infill konumunda bir infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mevcut SH Mode Profile'ı tamamen siler. SH alanı için saklanan balise grubu listesi de silinir.

steps.action: OBU'nun denetim durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: SH Mode Profile'ına ait hiçbir denetim kalmamıştır.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile SH Mode Profile'ın korunması (Referans başlangıcın ilerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir SH Mode Profile'ı denetlemektedir. SH Mode Profile başlangıcı L_sh_start'tır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA, referans konumu (L_infill) L_sh_start'ın ilerisinde olacak şekilde gönderilir. Infill MA içinde yeni bir Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesi bulunur.
test_cases.assumptions: L_infill > L_sh_start koşulu sağlanır.

steps.action: OBU'ya L_infill konumunda bir infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mevcut SH Mode Profile'ını silmez. Infill MA içindeki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesi yok sayılır (ignore edilir).

steps.action: OBU'nun denetim durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Orijinal SH Mode Profile'ı devam etmektedir. Yeni gelen bilgiler uygulanmamıştır.

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcının geçici EOA olarak kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili moda (OS/LS/SH) geçiş yapmamıştır. Mode Profile başlangıcı L_mp_start'tır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile, geçici SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA'da LOA tanımlı değildir.
test_cases.assumptions: Tren, L_mp_start konumunun gerisindedir.

steps.action: Tren, L_mp_start konumuna yaklaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, L_mp_start konumunu geçici EOA (End of Authority) olarak ele alır. Tren bu noktada durmalıdır.

steps.action: Tren, L_mp_start konumunda durdurulur.
steps.expected: Tren durur. OBU, moda geçiş yapmadığı için geçici EOA denetimi devam eder.

test_cases.title: Geçici SvL'nin Mode Profile başlangıcında uygulanması (Profil gerektiriyorsa)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili moda geçiş yapmamıştır. Mode Profile başlangıcı L_mp_start'tır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile, başlangıç noktasında geçici SvL (Supervised Limit) gerektirmektedir. Release speed tanımlı değildir.
test_cases.assumptions: Tren, L_mp_start konumunun gerisindedir.

steps.action: Tren, L_mp_start konumuna yaklaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, L_mp_start konumunda release speed'siz geçici SvL uygular. Tren bu noktada durmalıdır.

steps.action: Tren, L_mp_start konumunda durdurulur.
steps.expected: Tren durur. OBU, moda geçiş yapmadığı için geçici SvL denetimi devam eder.

test_cases.title: Geçici SvL'nin LOA'ya göre belirlenmesi (LOA profil başlangıcının ilerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili moda geçiş yapmamıştır. Mode Profile başlangıcı L_mp_start'tır. MA'da LOA (Limit of Authority) L_loa konumunda tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile, geçici SvL gerektirmemektedir. L_loa >= L_mp_start.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5'e göre, LOA verilmiş gibi davranılmayacaksa, LOA'nın konumu L_mp_start'ın ilerisinde veya eşit ise, geçici SvL L_mp_start'ta değil, §3.8.4.5'e göre belirlenen konumda olmalıdır. Ancak gereksinim metni 'as if no LOA had been given' ifadesini kullanır. Bu durumda, eğer LOA profil başlangıcının ilerisindeyse, geçici SvL'nin nerede olacağı §3.8.4.5'e göre belirlenir. Test senaryosu, LOA'nın profil başlangıcının ilerisinde olduğu durumu ele alır.

steps.action: Tren, L_mp_start konumuna yaklaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici EOA olarak ele alır. Geçici SvL, §3.8.4.5'e göre belirlenen konumda (LOA verilmiş gibi davranılmadığı için) uygulanır. Bu konum genellikle L_mp_start'tan farklı olabilir veya aynı olabilir, ancak gereksinim 'as if no LOA' ifadesini vurgular.

steps.action: Tren, belirlenen geçici SvL konumuna ulaşır.
steps.expected: Tren, belirlenen geçici SvL konumunda durur.

test_cases.title: Geçici SvL'nin Mode Profile başlangıcında uygulanması (LOA profil başlangıcının gerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili moda geçiş yapmamıştır. Mode Profile başlangıcı L_mp_start'tır. MA'da LOA (Limit of Authority) L_loa konumunda tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile, geçici SvL gerektirmemektedir. L_loa < L_mp_start.
test_cases.assumptions: LOA, Mode Profile başlangıcının gerisindedir.

steps.action: Tren, L_mp_start konumuna yaklaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici EOA olarak ele alır. LOA profil başlangıcının gerisinde olduğu için, geçici SvL L_mp_start konumunda uygulanır.

steps.action: Tren, L_mp_start konumunda durdurulur.
steps.expected: Tren durur. OBU, moda geçiş yapmadığı için geçici SvL denetimi devam eder.

test_cases.title: LX bilgisi kimlik çakışmasında yeni bilginin eskiyi değiştirmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, kimliği 'LX-001' olan ve korumalı (protected) olarak işaretlenmiş bir LX bilgisi almış ve depolamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kimliği 'LX-001' olan, korumasız (unprotected) olarak işaretlenmiş ve farklı bir uzunluğa sahip yeni bir LX profili verisi.

steps.action: OBU'ya kimliği 'LX-001' olan yeni LX bilgisi gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni LX bilgisini kabul eder ve depolanan eski LX bilgisini siler.

steps.action: Depolanan LX bilgisi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimliği 'LX-001' olan yeni LX bilgisini (korumasız durumu ve yeni uzunluğu ile) gösterir. Eski bilgiye ait parametreler bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Farklı kimlikli LX bilgilerinin bağımsızlığı
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, kimliği 'LX-001' olan bir LX bilgisi depolamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kimliği 'LX-002' olan yeni bir LX profili verisi.

steps.action: OBU'ya kimliği 'LX-002' olan yeni LX bilgisi gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni LX bilgisini depolar.

steps.action: Depolanan LX bilgileri sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Hem 'LX-001' hem de 'LX-002' kimlikli LX bilgileri bağımsız olarak depolarda bulunur. 'LX-001' bilgisi 'LX-002' alımı nedeniyle değiştirilmez veya silinmez.

test_cases.title: AAL2 için phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneğinin sunulması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama gerektiren bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli şirket temsilcisi kimlik bilgileri ve desteklenen bir phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulayıcı (ör. FIDO2/WebAuthn anahtarı).
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.2.5'e uygun en az bir phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama yöntemi (ör. FIDO2/WebAuthn) desteklemektedir.

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi hesabıyla AAL2 gerektiren bir sayfaya erişim sağlanır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama ekranı, en az bir phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneğini (ör. 'FIDO2 Anahtarı ile Giriş Yap') görünür şekilde sunar.

steps.action: Phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneği seçilir ve geçerli kimlik doğrulayıcı kullanılarak işlem tamamlanır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı AAL2 korumalı alana erişim sağlar.

test_cases.title: Phishing-dirençli seçeneğin AAL2 girişinde kullanılabilirliği
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama gerektiren bir oturum başlatmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kayıtlı bir FIDO2/WebAuthn kimlik doğrulayıcı.
test_cases.assumptions: Tarayıcı, WebAuthn API'lerini desteklemektedir.

steps.action: Giriş ekranında phishing-dirençli kimlik doğrulama seçeneği (ör. 'Güvenli Anahtar ile Giriş') aranır.
steps.expected: Seçenek, diğer kimlik doğrulama yöntemleriyle birlikte veya onlardan bağımsız olarak seçilebilir durumda listelenir.

steps.action: Seçilen phishing-dirençli yöntemle kimlik doğrulama işlemi başlatılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, tarayıcıya WebAuthn istemi gönderir ve kimlik doğrulayıcıdan gelen yanıtı doğrular.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with multi-factor authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication using a multi-factor authenticator (e.g., a cryptographically secure device with an integrated biometric sensor).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid multi-factor authenticator credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The multi-factor authenticator is enrolled and active in the system.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the multi-factor authenticator input.

steps.action: Provide the required inputs to the multi-factor authenticator (e.g., biometric scan and device unlock).
steps.expected: The system verifies the possession and control of the authenticator.

steps.action: Complete the authentication event.
steps.expected: The system grants access to the portal, confirming successful AAL2 authentication.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with combination of two separate factors
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication using a combination of a physical authenticator (e.g., out-of-band device) and a password.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password and valid out-of-band device code.
test_cases.assumptions: The out-of-band device is enrolled and active in the system.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the password.

steps.action: Enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second factor (out-of-band device code).

steps.action: Enter the valid code from the out-of-band device.
steps.expected: The system verifies both factors and grants access to the portal, confirming successful AAL2 authentication.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with single factor only
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication using a combination of a physical authenticator and a password.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password only.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the password.

steps.action: Enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second factor.

steps.action: Attempt to proceed without providing the second factor.
steps.expected: The system denies access and displays an error message indicating that two factors are required for AAL2 authentication.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with invalid second factor
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication using a combination of a physical authenticator and a password.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password and invalid out-of-band device code.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the password.

steps.action: Enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second factor.

steps.action: Enter an invalid code from the out-of-band device.
steps.expected: The system denies access and displays an error message indicating that the second factor is invalid.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunda inactivity timeout'unun tetiklenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulamasını tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP SDD §14'te tanımlanan inactivity timeout süresi (örneğin 1 saat) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP SDD §14'te AAL2 için inactivity timeout süresinin 1 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Oturum açıldıktan sonra, inactivity timeout süresinin dolmasını bekleyin (örneğin 1 saat boyunca hiçbir etkileşimde bulunmayın).
steps.expected: Sistem, inactivity timeout'unun dolduğunu algılar ve oturumu sonlandırır.

steps.action: Oturum sonlandıktan sonra, portalın herhangi bir sayfasına erişmeye çalışın.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı, yeniden kimlik doğrulama (reauthentication) ekranına yönlendirilir veya oturumun sonlandığına dair bir uyarı alır.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunda overall timeout'unun tetiklenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulamasını tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP SDD §14'te tanımlanan overall timeout süresi (örneğin 24 saat) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP SDD §14'te AAL2 için overall timeout süresinin 24 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Oturum açıldıktan sonra, overall timeout süresinin dolmasını bekleyin (örneğin 24 saat boyunca, inactivity timeout'unu sıfırlamak için periyodik olarak küçük etkileşimler yapın).
steps.expected: Sistem, overall timeout'unun dolduğunu algılar ve oturumu sonlandırır.

steps.action: Oturum sonlandıktan sonra, portalın herhangi bir sayfasına erişmeye çalışın.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı, yeniden kimlik doğrulama (reauthentication) ekranına yönlendirilir veya oturumun sonlandığına dair bir uyarı alır.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunda inactivity timeout'unun etkileşimle sıfırlanması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulamasını tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP SDD §14'te tanımlanan inactivity timeout süresi (örneğin 1 saat) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP SDD §14'te AAL2 için inactivity timeout süresinin 1 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Oturum açıldıktan 30 dakika sonra, sayfada bir tıklama veya kaydırma gibi bir etkileşim gerçekleştirin.
steps.expected: Sistem, inactivity timeout sayacını sıfırlar.

steps.action: Etkileşimden sonra 45 dakika daha bekleyin (toplamda ilk girişten 75 dakika, son etkileşimden 45 dakika).
steps.expected: Oturum hâlâ aktiftir, çünkü son etkileşimden itibaren inactivity timeout süresi dolmamıştır.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunda başarılı yeniden kimlik doğrulamanın timeout'ları sıfırlaması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulamasını tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP SDD §14'te tanımlanan inactivity ve overall timeout süreleri yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP SDD §14'te AAL2 için inactivity timeout'unun 1 saat, overall timeout'unun 24 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Oturum açıldıktan 23 saat sonra, sistem tarafından istenen yeniden kimlik doğrulama (reauthentication) işlemini başarıyla tamamlayın.
steps.expected: Sistem, hem inactivity hem de overall timeout sayaçlarını sıfırlar.

steps.action: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama sonrası 1 saat boyunca etkileşimde bulunmadan bekleyin.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır, çünkü sıfırlanan inactivity timeout süresi dolmuştur.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunda inactivity timeout sınırında davranış
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulamasını tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP SDD §14'te tanımlanan inactivity timeout süresi (örneğin 1 saat) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP SDD §14'te AAL2 için inactivity timeout süresinin 1 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Oturum açıldıktan 59 dakika 59 saniye sonra, sayfada bir tıklama gibi bir etkileşim gerçekleştirin.
steps.expected: Oturum hâlâ aktiftir, çünkü inactivity timeout süresi dolmamıştır.

steps.action: Etkileşimden sonra 1 dakika daha bekleyin (toplamda ilk girişten 1 saat 1 dakika, son etkileşimden 1 dakika).
steps.expected: Oturum hâlâ aktiftir, çünkü son etkileşimden itibaren inactivity timeout süresi dolmamıştır.

test_cases.title: Account recovery notification sent to representative
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a valid notification address (email or postal) configured. The account is in a state where recovery can be initiated (e.g., locked or compromised).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials or recovery code for the company representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification system is operational and capable of sending emails or postal mail. The representative's notification address is correctly stored in the system.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The recovery process completes successfully, and the account is restored or unlocked.

steps.action: Check the notification log or the representative's notification channel (e.g., email inbox or postal mail tracking) for a recovery notification.
steps.expected: A notification regarding the account recovery is present, addressed to the representative or their designee, containing clear instructions and contact information as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.2.3.

test_cases.title: Account recovery notification sent to designee
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a designated alternate contact (designee) configured for notifications. The primary representative's contact is unavailable or the designee is the active notification target.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the company representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The designee's notification address is correctly stored and active in the system.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The recovery process completes successfully.

steps.action: Verify that the recovery notification was sent to the designee's notification address.
steps.expected: The notification is received by the designee, confirming that the system correctly routes notifications to the designated alternate contact when specified.

test_cases.title: Recovery notification content includes required instructions
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is set up for recovery. A test notification channel (e.g., a monitored email address) is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification template includes fields for instructions and contact information as required by NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.2.3.

steps.action: Trigger an account recovery event for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The recovery is processed successfully.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent notification.
steps.expected: The notification contains clear instructions for the recipient and includes contact information in case the recipient repudiates the event, complying with NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.2.3.

test_cases.title: Bildirimlerin tüm elektronik adreslere gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı oluşturulmuştur ve en az bir e-posta ve bir SMS adresi kayıtlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hesap bildirimini tetikleyecek bir olay (ör. şifre sıfırlama isteği).
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, e-posta ve SMS gönderimlerini loglara kaydetmektedir.

steps.action: Hesap bildirimini tetikleyecek bir olay başlatılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, kayıtlı e-posta adresine ve SMS numarasına bildirim gönderir.

steps.action: Gönderim logları incelenir.
steps.expected: Loglarda e-posta ve SMS gönderimlerinin başarılı olduğu görülür.

test_cases.title: Posta adresine bildirim gönderilmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi hesabında hem posta adresi hem de e-posta adresi kayıtlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hesap bildirimini tetikleyecek bir olay.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, posta gönderimlerini loglara kaydetmektedir.

steps.action: Hesap bildirimini tetikleyecek bir olay başlatılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, kayıtlı e-posta adresine bildirim gönderir.

steps.action: Gönderim logları incelenir.
steps.expected: Loglarda posta adresine herhangi bir bildirim gönderimi bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Sadece posta adresi kayıtlıysa bildirim gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi hesabında yalnızca posta adresi kayıtlıdır, başka bir bildirim adresi yoktur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hesap bildirimini tetikleyecek bir olay.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, posta gönderimlerini loglara kaydetmektedir.

steps.action: Hesap bildirimini tetikleyecek bir olay başlatılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, kayıtlı posta adresine bildirim gönderir.

steps.action: Gönderim logları incelenir.
steps.expected: Loglarda posta adresine bildirim gönderiminin başarılı olduğu görülür.

test_cases.title: VBP session persists after e-Devlet assertion validity window expires
test_cases.preconditions: Citizen has successfully authenticated via e-Devlet and an active VBP session exists. The e-Devlet assertion validity window is known (e.g., 5 minutes).
test_cases.assumptions: The e-Devlet assertion validity window is set to a short duration (e.g., 5 minutes) for testing purposes, or the system clock can be manipulated to simulate the passage of time beyond the validity window.

steps.action: Wait until the e-Devlet assertion validity window has expired (e.g., wait 6 minutes if the window is 5 minutes).
steps.expected: The VBP session remains active. The user can still access protected resources without re-authentication.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected page or API endpoint within the VBP.
